channel.title: Dhiraj Kumar Sah — Writing
channel.description: Essays on AI governance, data literacy and building a company in Canada.

item.title: Governance for AI agents is an architecture problem, not a prompt
item.description: Why I think the rules an AI agent follows have to live underneath the model, in the runtime, rather than in instructions the model can talk itself out of.

item.title: Building a company in Canada while driving for Uber
item.description: An honest account of the first year of Zerava Technologies Inc.: why I chose a company over a job, what the days actually look like, and what I would tell someone starting from the same place.

item.title: Data literacy is a policy question, not a training course
item.description: What building a branchless-banking system in rural Nepal taught me about who gets to understand the data that governs them, and why it matters more as AI systems take over the decisions.
